newsitem.title: FRANCE: Unmarked cow-pat on French road leads to damages.
newsitem.headline: Unmarked cow-pat on French road leads to damages.

text.p: An unmarked cow-pat on a country road that sent a motorcyclist into a spin led a court on Thursday to order the French department of Hautes Pyrenees to pay the biker 27,321 francs ($5,274) in damages.
The motorcyclist from Gers in southwestern France complained to an administrative court after his accident that there had been no road-side sign warning of cow-pats.

Departmental council president Francois Fortassin said he would not contest the ruling. "I see the humour in this, but it will prove costly to taxpayers as we will have to put up hundreds of warning signs along our mountainous rural roads," Fortassin said.
